newsitem.title: FRANCE: Top Algerian trade unionist dead - official.
newsitem.headline: Top Algerian trade unionist dead - official.

text.p: Moslem fundamentalists shot dead Algeria's top trade union leader Abdelhak Benhamouda on Tuesday, the Interior Minister said in a statement on the official Algerian news agency APS.

Minister Mustapha Ben Mansour said the union leader was killed in a "terrorist attack" - Algeria's official term for attacks by fundamentalists -- early in the afternoon outside the union headquarters.
Mustapha's statement said his death was "a heavy loss", and vowed to hunt down and "punish with rigour" those responsible.
Benhamouda, a former teacher in his 40s, headed the one-million strong umbrella Union Generale Des Travailleurs Algeriens (UGTA).

But he said recently he would step down to form his own political party, criticising lack of political activity in ending the country's five-year-old conflict between security forces and armed Moslem radicals.
